Team — kicking off the annual planning cadence. Goal here is to lock a preliminary KPI slate, agree on 2–3 staffing scenarios (base / growth / conservative), and land QBR prep owners so we have a clean pre-read for Exec by Apr 9.

Attachments: QBR-templates-v2.xlsx (spreadsheet stub), staffing-scenarios.pdf (draft)

Proposed timeline (high level):
- Mar 21–27: owners fill target slate + committee reviews
- Mar 28–Apr 3: cross-functional gap analysis (CS, Eng, Product)
- Apr 4–9: QBR pre-read assembled and leadership dry-run

Immediate asks:
1) Laura — please propose a baseline revenue target band and two downside scenarios by EOD Mar 24.
2) Marissa — can you draft staffing deltas for each scenario (headcount and TTM impact) and share by Mar 26?
3) Jonas — please confirm Exec availability Apr 10–11 for the dry-run; if not, propose alternatives.
4) Lauren/Kimberly — owner assignment for deck sections (Ops / Infra / Cost).

Link to workspace: https://drive.google.com/open?id=1a2b3cQBRtemplates (I added the QBR template and a short checklist).

Keep items tight — this is a minimal-scope kickoff. I want one pager per owner and a short slide set. If you're blocked by data, call out the gap and who can unblock.

Thanks,
Vivek

Looping Marta from Acme — her team has been through a similar staffing-scenarios exercise last year and offered to share a short template and caveats (Marta, appreciate the quick turnaround if possible).

I've attached a draft staffing delta matrix per scenario (base / growth / conservative). Highlights:
- Base: modest hiring in Product (+3 FTE), Eng (+6 FTE, mix infra/serving), CS (+2) — roughly flat OPEX / 6% headcount growth
- Growth: accelerate Eng hiring to +12 FTE, add 1 CS manager — pushes ops cost ~9% but supports higher throughput targets
- Conservative: hiring freeze except critical roles; redeploy contractors — shows negative headcount delta net -4 (cost savings ~5%)

Key risks: GPU provisioning lead times, SRE backlog affecting launch velocity for Dedicated pools. Recommend a short risk register column in the final slide set with owners.

Attachments: staffing-scenarios.pdf (draft, 3 pages)

Marissa Cole
Director, GTM Ops
